end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '扶绥县' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E6%89%B6%E7%BB%A5%E5%8E%BF) -- county-seat town-level anchor (city-type node) for Fusui County, Chongzuo, Guangxi; the pigging station itself is not separately mapped.

P7654.corridor_notes: The Guangxi Gas Investment Engineering & Procurement (gigeps.com) project-announcement page for '广西天然气支线管网项目南宁-扶绥天然气支线管道工程' states the line starts at '西气东输二线南宁-百色支线工程吴圩分输清管站' (the Wuxu distribution/pigging station on PipeChina's West-East Gas Pipeline Line 2, Nanning-Baise branch), located in Jiangnan District, Nanning, and ends at '扶绥-崇左支线扶绥清管站围墙外 2m' (2m outside the perimeter wall of the Fusui pigging station on the Fusui-Chongzuo branch), Fusui County, Chongzuo. Route runs '沿线途经南宁市江南区及崇左市扶绥县' (Jiangnan District, Nanning through to Fusui County, Chongzuo). Stated length ~19.50 km (vs GEM's 20.00 km -- close, plausible planning-estimate vs as-built rounding), diameter D355.6mm (exact match to GEM's Diameter), design pressure 6.3MPa (exact match to GEM's Pressure), L360M ERW steel pipe. No major river/rail/highway crossings noted, but the filing flags 'san chuan' (three types of minor crossings) in its construction scope.
P7654.researcher_notes: This resolves the pilot pass's EXISTENCE concern: all 4 of GEM's originally-cited refs were dead/unreachable/empty, but an independent project-announcement page on gigeps.com (Guangxi's official gas-infrastructure-investment engineering & procurement portal) names the identical project ('广西天然气支线管网项目南宁-扶绥天然气支线管道工程') and independently corroborates Diameter (355.6mm, exact) and Pressure (6.3MPa, exact match to the sheet's cited-but-dead fgw.nanning.gov.cn values), plus a length (~19.5km) very close to GEM's 20km. Additional corroboration: a DuckDuckGo search also surfaced two Guangxi Water Resources Department (slt.gxzf.gov.cn) filings referencing the identical project name for its soil-and-water-conservation plan, but both slt.gxzf.gov.cn URLs are unreachable from this sandbox (ECONNREFUSED, same geo-block pattern as fgw.gxzf.gov.cn) and have no Wayback snapshot obtainable right now (archive.org rate-limited this session) -- not used as refs, but their existence (real government agency, real project name) further supports this segment being genuinely real, not phantom. On the pilot's DUPLICATE concern vs P4725 ('Fusui County->Guangxi', 83km, same diameter 355.6mm/capacity 0.85bcm/y, status=construction): this newly-found source describes P7654 as tapping the West-East Line 2 (Nanning-Baise branch) at Wuxu and terminating just outside the Fusui pigging station on a *separate* named corridor ('扶绥-崇左支线', the Fusui-Chongzuo branch) -- i.e. P7654 (Wuxu->Fusui, ~19.5-20km) reads as a distinct feeder segment INTO the Fusui pigging station, while P4725 (83km, under construction) is plausibly further downstream on that same Fusui-Chongzuo branch corridor, not the same physical pipe. Shared diameter/capacity across two segments of one corridor network is unsurprising (same design spec applied network-wide) rather than evidence of a relabeled duplicate. Not setting duplicate_of, but flagging this reasoning for human side-by-side review since I could not obtain the Fusui-Chongzuo branch's full alignment to rule it out with certainty.

start.geocode_source: Nominatim query '邕宁区,南宁市' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E9%82%95%E5%AE%81%E5%8C%BA%2C%E5%8D%97%E5%AE%81%E5%B8%82) -- the source article states only that 'the entire pipeline lies within Yongning District' (该管道全线位于邕宁区境内) without a finer address for the Sinopec station itself, so this is a district-level anchor (Yongning District place node), not station-precise.

end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '蒲庙镇,邕宁区' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E8%92%B2%E5%BA%99%E9%95%87%2C%E9%82%95%E5%AE%81%E5%8C%BA) -- returned Pumiao Town government office (蒲庙镇人民政府) as a town-level anchor; the source pins the station more precisely as west of 蕾赖村 (Leilai village) and east of 疏港大道 (Harbor Road), but neither the village nor the road segment is separately resolvable in Nominatim.

P7656.corridor_notes: Guangxi Daily / Guangxi News Net article (v.gxnews.com.cn, 2020-04-30) on the groundbreaking of '南宁市天然气专供管道工程（中石化南宁站-南宁中燃门站段）' states verbatim: '工程起自中石化南宁站' (the project begins at Sinopec Nanning Station) and '止于邕宁区蒲庙镇蕾赖村西侧、疏港大道东侧的新建蒲庙分输站' (terminates at the newly-built Pumiao distribution station, west of Leilai village and east of Harbor Road, Pumiao Town, Yongning District), adding '该管道全线位于邕宁区境内' (the entire pipeline lies within Yongning District). Total length ~8.9km (exact match to GEM's LengthKnown), groundbreaking 2020-04-28, planned 8-month construction, total investment 67.55 million RMB.
P7656.researcher_notes: Building on the pilot pass, which already confirmed existence/classification/specs via this same source: this pass extracted the precise start/end station names and corridor description needed for route drawing. Both endpoints resolve only to district/town level in open geocoding (the underlying source names the stations but not a street address); the finer village/road detail (蕾赖村, 疏港大道) narrows the likely true site of the end station but could not be independently pinned with Nominatim.

start.name_en: Leitang Distribution Station (built for Sinopec's Guangxi LNG project pipeline)
start.geocode_source: Nominatim query '黎塘镇' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E9%BB%8E%E5%A1%98%E9%95%87) -- returned the Leitang town place node (Binyang County, Nanning, Guangxi), a town-level anchor since the station's exact plot is not separately mapped in OSM.

end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '宾阳镇,宾阳县' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E5%AE%BE%E9%98%B3%E9%95%87%2C%E5%AE%BE%E9%98%B3%E5%8E%BF) -- returned the Binyang County government office as a county-seat anchor. The source pins the station more precisely as northeast of 塘表村 (Tangbiao village), but that village name returned no match in Nominatim (only same-named villages in Guangdong/Qinzhou, wrong location) -- so this is a county-seat-level fallback, coarser than the source's own village-level description.

P7658.corridor_notes: Two government-mandated post-construction environmental filings by Guangxi Gas Group (2025-07-30 completion disclosure and 2026-07-23 final acceptance report, both on yanshougs.com) state verbatim: '出自中石化广西液化天然气（LNG）项目输气管道已建的黎塘分输站' (originates from the existing Leitang distribution station, built for Sinopec's Guangxi LNG project pipeline) and '终于位于宾阳县塘表村东北侧的宾阳分输站' (terminates at the Binyang distribution station, northeast of Tangbiao village, Binyang County). Route runs westward from Leitang through four townships: 黎塘镇 (Leitang), 洋桥镇 (Yangqiao), 王灵镇 (Wangling), 大桥镇 (Daqiao) -- all within Binyang County, Nanning. As-built length 23.9196-23.925 km (the two filings differ slightly), D273.1mm pipe, 4MPa design pressure, design throughput 2.91e8 Nm3/a (0.291 bcm/y) -- Diameter, Pressure and Capacity all exact matches to GEM's recorded values; Length is ~3km/~11% shorter than GEM's current 27km (reads as pre-construction estimate vs as-built, flagged by the pilot pass, not corrected here).
P7658.researcher_notes: Confirms and extends the prior pass's findings exactly -- both yanshougs.com URLs re-verified OK via url_verifier this pass. Township order along the route (west from Leitang): Leitang -> Yangqiao -> Wangling -> Daqiao -> Binyang distribution station near Tangbiao village. No duplicate found elsewhere in the Guangxi roster referencing these place names.
P7658.blockers: Village-level precision for the Binyang end (塘表村/Tangbiao) could not be geocoded via Nominatim -- coordinates fall back to the Binyang county-seat point, coarser than the sourced description.

end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '武鸣区,南宁市' (https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=%E6%AD%A6%E9%B8%A3%E5%8C%BA%2C%E5%8D%97%E5%AE%81%E5%B8%82) -- returned the Wuming district-seat place node; district-level fallback, same reasoning as the start point.

P7675.corridor_notes: A 2025-02-28 Sina Finance article (re-syndicated from a Guangxi Energy Group / Guangtou Pipe Network release, and matching the nationalee.com press release already cited by GEM) states: '隆安—武鸣天然气支线管道工程...管道起自国家管网西二线南宁-百色支线5#阀室，新建管道50公里、2座分输站和1座阀室' (the Long'an-Wuming gas branch pipeline originates at Valve Chamber #5 on PipeChina's West-East Gas Pipeline Line 2, Nanning-Baise branch; newly built 50 km of pipe, 2 distribution stations and 1 monitoring valve chamber) and names the two stations explicitly: '沿线设置分输站2座（隆安分输站、武鸣分输站）' (Long'an distribution station and Wuming distribution station). Design specs: horizontal length 49.46km, D323.9mm, 6.3MPa design pressure, design throughput 4.4e8 Nm3/a (0.44 bcm/y) -- all consistent with GEM's recorded values. '隆安分输站顺利投产，武鸣分输站成功进气' (Long'an station commissioned, Wuming station received gas) as of the 2025-03 commissioning. Neither source gives the exact township/village for either station beyond the county/district name.
P7675.researcher_notes: Builds on the pilot pass, which flagged FuelSource misattribution (should be West-East Line 2 Nanning-Baise branch, not Sino-Myanmar) and a segment_name transcription slip ('Longming-Wu'an' should be 'Long'an-Wuming') -- both confirmed again here via a second, independently-published outlet (finance.sina.com.cn, matching the nationalee.com wire story almost verbatim, still counts only as corroborating republication per the corroboration rule, not a second independent source). This second fetch additionally surfaced the exact station names (隆安分输站, 武鸣分输站) and the tie-in point (5# valve chamber on West-East Line 2's Nanning-Baise branch), which the pilot pass's single source did not spell out. A bibenet.com procurement notice ('公路一期涉及横县支线与上林至横县高速公路交叉改线工程和隆安-武鸣支线接驳国家管网南百线改扩建工程隆安分输站段线路工程施工') independently confirms the project name and the Long'an-station tie-in construction scope but returned HTTP 403 on fetch attempts, so it was not used as a ref, only as supporting context.

P7661.corridor_notes: 央广网 (CNR) article dated 2025-01-17, titled '韩凯：建设防城港至东兴天然气支线管道', quotes Han Kai (Party Secretary/Director, Fangchenggang Development & Reform Commission) at the 2025 Guangxi 'two sessions' recommending the government build a Fangchenggang-to-Dongxing natural gas branch pipeline: '全长约40公里，总投资约8000万元' (total length ~40 km, total investment ~80 million RMB) -- both exact matches to GEM. This is explicitly framed as a legislative recommendation ('我建议加快建设...并纳入2025年开工计划', urging inclusion in the 2025 construction-start plan), consistent with GEM's Status='proposed'. No station names, specific townships, or a detailed alignment have been published -- this is pre-approval/pre-EIA, so only the two endpoint cities are sourced.
P7661.researcher_notes: Confirms the pilot pass's finding: this is a real, publicly-recommended proposal (not a phantom entry) but remains pre-approval as of the newest evidence (2025-01-17); no construction-start, tender, or EIA filing was found in this pass either, so no finer-than-city route detail exists to source yet. news.qq.com/rain/a/20250117A01W2T00 is the identical wire story re-syndicated same-day -- verified OK but does not count as a second independent source per the corroboration rule, so this stays medium-confidence on a single primary source (the CNR original). Coordinates are necessarily coarse (city-level) given the proposal stage; a route-creation pass should revisit once an approval/EIA names actual stations.
P7661.blockers: No station-level or township-level route detail is publicly available yet -- this is a legislative recommendation with no formal approval, EIA, or engineering filing found. Endpoint coordinates are city-level anchors, not a sourced alignment.
